- **Test the docs by applying their SQL to the live local database inside a rolled-back transaction**: Proves the docs are executable and lets the real catalog answer questions about RLS and grants, without creating migrations or leaving data behind (alternatives: Read the docs only; Put the SQL into supabase/migrations and run db reset)
